title: First violin lessons at age seven; his musician father
summary: Howard began violin lessons at seven; his father played violin, cornet and piano in Chicago night spots.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When did you first learn music?
I mean, playing or lessons? Lessons. Only. I was 7 years old.
Violin. Was it a private teacher or at school?
Yeah. I studied under a teacher that gave my father some lessons.
Violin. Cornel and piano. Where? In Chicago.
Oh, he played in night spots. When he became ill, he was working at a place called Pony Morris, 21st and Warbash.
He was a dance man musician, then. Thank you, sir.
Thanks. Well, I don't know about the dance band. It wasn't so... A little different than night life, then. More singing and feature numbers, you know? You know how much dance music?
